_about: Jak II's prefabs: ready-made assemblies of Jak II's decor, made by the editor from the user's own extracted Jak II levels (no data of the game here: names of levels and decor parts only), brought into Jak 3 levels as its structures are (textures named jak2-<name>). Same fields as data/jak3/prefabs.json; see src/io/prefab_recipes.h.

prefabs.name: Haven tall building
prefabs.description: A tall building of Haven's streets in Jak II, its facades, pipes and roofs.

prefabs.name: Port loading tower
prefabs.description: A loading tower of Haven's port, with its machinery.

prefabs.name: Slum stilt house
prefabs.description: A shack of Haven's slums built on stilts over the water, its sheet metal walls and its roofs.

prefabs.name: Pumping station tank
prefabs.description: A tank of the pumping station, lying on its frame.

prefabs.name: Nest cannon
prefabs.description: The great cannon of the Metal Head nest, with its barrel, pipes and generator.

prefabs.name: Haven palace
prefabs.description: The Baron's palace on its pillar over Haven, whole, as the city sees it from afar (its low-detail model): 400 m across, 570 m high.

prefabs.name: Palace roof
prefabs.description: The top of the Baron's palace: its roofs, spires and terraces, where Jak climbs (7,000 elements).

prefabs.name: Palace entrance
prefabs.description: The round hall at the entrance of the Baron's palace, its walls, platforms and windows.

prefabs.name: Palace fountain
prefabs.description: The round fountain of the palace's gardens, with its pillars and statues.

prefabs.name: Palace gardens
prefabs.description: The palace's gardens in Haven whole: their walls, canopies, flowerbeds and vines, the raised terrace around them with its slabs and balustrades (the square under them is the level's ground).
